name: ambient
description: An animated strip above the prompt that moves with the work, in eight styles from a request mesh to a lava lamp

style.title: Style
style.description: What the strip shows: network, critter, aurora, synthwave, warp, murmuration, lava or wave. /ambient styles describes each; a style picked with /ambient wins over this

rows.title: Strip height
rows.description: Rows the strip takes above the prompt, 1 to 6 (critter uses at least 3, synthwave at least 4)

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: How bright the strip draws: soft, bright or vivid

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: Colors for every style but network. auto follows the current ccs-theme Ghostty theme
